trap.label: recuo de tempo e marcadores
trap.wrong: She said the festival starts Friday. She said tickets are free and it started tomorrow.
trap.right: She said it would start on Friday. She said tickets were free.
trap.why: Em português “disse que começa sexta” mantém o presente. Em inglês, o discurso indireto recua o verbo (starts → would start; are → were) e mudam marcadores (tomorrow → the next day).

mcq.q: “Tickets are free.” → She said tickets ___ free.
“It starts Friday.” → She said it ___ start Friday.
“I am here.” → He said he was ___.

fix.wrong: He said he will come tomorrow.
fix.right: He said he would come the next day.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The show ends at nine.” (She said...)
rewrite.answer: She said the show ended at nine.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I will be here tomorrow.” (He said...)
rewrite.answer: He said he would be there the next day.
